title: 第17章 人一定要靠自己第18章 拳馆总教练
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 林野走到悬崖近前，伸出手轻轻触摸崖壁。
苔藓的手感摸上去有些扎手，还有些滑腻，夹杂着一些透明黏液。
扫了一眼，拉住一根藤蔓拽了拽，不到半指粗细，拽了几下没有扯断。
还算坚韧，但这藤蔓的根系扎在岩缝里，显然是承受不住一个成年人体重的。
估计顺着爬上去几米就得摔下来。
抬头观察悬崖，通体石质，呈现出坚固的灰黑颜色。
后退几步，他整体观察一阵，抬手指向崖顶上的几棵老松。
“老人家，我回去买几根登山绳，到时候从那里挂下来，您给帮忙看着点。”
老人抬起头看过去，拿起望远镜观察一会后，‘啧’了一声皱起眉头。
“林老师，这太危险了。”
“这里是背阴面，上边苔藓多，太滑了，根本站不住人的。”
“您能花这么多钱买迭罗子，肯定也不差钱，没必要冒这个险的。”
他想不明白，这位林老师为什么要冒险摘这东西。
虽说野生的是比养殖的好，可林老师也不像差钱的主，还能买不到真货？
林野忍不住搓了搓指腹，笑容有些发僵。
“就这么定了。三天之后我来摘，到时候算你两成，差不多就是五株。”
“或者干脆折给你两千都可以，随你选。”
虽说野山里的山货都是无主的，但再怎么说也是人家找的地方。
这犄角旮旯的位置要是让他自己找，估计找上十天都不一定找得到。
况且，老人家跟孙子两人在这山里生活也不容易，多少得让人赚点。
算起来，只要把这些黑螺形草卖了，还是他大赚了一笔。
就是不知道黑螺形草的卖价和学校内网的收购价有没有出入。
如果跟迭罗子的情况一样那就......
不过，就算是亏了他也认，生意当然是有的赚就有可能亏。
“不用不用，您出那么高价买老头子的迭罗子就已经是帮了大忙，不能再要了。”
老人家急忙摆手，林老师这样的好人可难找啊！
“老头子只气自己身子不利索了，不然老头子就自个上去摘了，肯定不能让林老师冒这个险。”
“到时候您知会一声就行，老头子一定给您看好绳！”
“您放心！要是有什么意外，老头子也不让您自个上路！我那意外险早都买好了！就等个机会用呢！”
天色渐暗，海岸市‘林氏’大型连锁商场外。
content_en:
Lin Ye walked closer to the cliff and stretched out his hand to gently touch the cliff.
The moss feels prickly and slippery, mixed with some transparent mucus.
After taking a quick look, I grabbed a vine and pulled it. It was less than half a finger thick, and it didn't break after a few pulls.
It's fairly tough, but the vine's roots are rooted in the rock crevices, and it's obvious that it can't bear the weight of an adult.
It is estimated that you will have to fall down after climbing up for a few meters.
Looking up at the cliff, it is entirely made of stone, showing a solid gray and black color.
He took a few steps back, observed the whole situation for a while, and raised his hand to point to some old pines on the top of the cliff.
"Old man, I'll go back and buy some climbing ropes. Then I can hang them from there. You can help me keep an eye on them."
The old man raised his head and looked over. After picking up the telescope and observing for a while, he made a 'tsk' sound and frowned.
"Teacher Lin, this is too dangerous."
"This is the shady side. There's a lot of moss on it and it's too slippery for people to stand on."
"If you can spend so much money to buy Delozi, you are definitely not short of money. There is no need to take this risk."
He couldn't understand why Teacher Lin would risk picking this thing.
Although the wild ones are better than the farmed ones, Teacher Lin is not like a shop owner who is short of money. How can he not buy the real thing?
Lin Ye couldn't help but rub his fingertips, his smile a little stiff.
"That's it. I'll pick them in three days. Then I'll count you 20%, which is almost five plants."
"Or I can just give you a discount of two thousand, it's your choice."
Although the wild products in the wild mountains are all ownerless, after all, they are still a place for people to find them.
If he had to look for this corner by himself, he might not be able to find it even after ten days of searching.
Moreover, it is not easy for the old man and his grandson to live in the mountains, so they have to make some money.
All in all, as long as he sells these black spiral grasses, he will still make a huge profit.
I just don’t know if there is any discrepancy between the selling price of the black spiral grass and the purchase price on the school intranet.
If the situation is the same as that of Delozi, then...
However, even if he loses money, he admits that in business, of course, some profits may be lost.
"No, no, you have already done a great favor by paying such a high price for the old man's Delozi. I can't ask for any more."
The old man waved his hands hurriedly, "It's hard to find a good person like Teacher Lin!"
"The old man is only angry that he is not in good health. Otherwise, the old man would go up and pick it by himself. Teacher Lin must not be allowed to take this risk."
"Just let me know when the time comes, and the old man will definitely watch the rope for you!"
"Don't worry! If there's any accident, the old man won't let you go on the road alone! I've already bought the accident insurance! I'm just waiting for a chance to use it!"
...
The sky is getting dark, outside the large chain shopping mall "Lin's" in Coast City.
